searchText: Goerli is past the blob expiry window, so we started a range of sync tests. Results: lh-geth with checkpoint sync: both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side, 20h left for historic blocks lodestar-erigon with checkpoint sync, CL synced and EL is still syncing, expected to take ~2 more days atleast nimbus-reth with checkpoint sync, CL synced and EL is still syncing, expected to take ~1 more day prysm-nethermind with checkpoint sync, both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side teku-besu with checkpoint sync, both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side lighthouse-geth WITHOUT checkpoint sync, seems stalled and EL has no messages. could <@491624610215886849> or someone from lh have a look and ensure my flags aren't off? (`ssh devops@161.35.148.225`) will check in a bit the issue is that none of the peers have data upto genesis. and there's currently no way of knowing in protocol that a peer that is "Synced" also has all the blocks before the weak subjectivity period. So lighthouse is asking peers for blocks, they are sending empty responses and sync isn't moving forward also, nimbus seems to be sending empty responses instead of a ResourceUnavailable error for range requests https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/issues/4053 empty is a correct response here ie `ResourceUnavailable` is a "should" there's no way to know this in general except by receiving a block from the peer (it could lie about being synced) yeah i guess, but it doesn't help us when syncing from genesis atleast specially if all peers are returning empty responses well, the action you take in this case is the same as if you received ResourceUnavailable, which is to use a different peer for the same range, so I'm not sure `ResourceUnavailable` would help you ie an empty response means "unknown" for that slot range - you have to confirm it with other means (for example receiving blocks "around" the range you requested that confirm that there were no blocks in that range in that history

excerpts.content:
Goerli is past the blob expiry window, so we started a range of sync tests. Results:

lh-geth with checkpoint sync: both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side, 20h left for historic blocks

lodestar-erigon with checkpoint sync, CL synced and EL is still syncing, expected to take ~2 more days atleast

nimbus-reth with checkpoint sync, CL synced and EL is still syncing, expected to take ~1 more day

prysm-nethermind with checkpoint sync, both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side

teku-besu with checkpoint sync, both EL and CL at head and verified payloads on CL side

lighthouse-geth WITHOUT checkpoint sync, seems stalled and EL has no messages. could <@491624610215886849> or someone from lh have a look and ensure my flags aren't off? (`ssh devops@161.35.148.225`)

excerpts.author: pawandhananjay
excerpts.content: the issue is that none of the peers have data upto genesis. and there's currently no way of knowing in protocol that a peer that is "Synced" also has all the blocks before the weak subjectivity period. So lighthouse is asking peers for blocks, they are sending empty responses and sync isn't moving forward
